prompt: Create a website for an interior designer in the Peninsula, Bay Area
summary: A brochure-style website for a Bay Area Peninsula interior design studio. Since the site only needs to showcase portfolio work, services, and contact info with no server-side data changes, a single static site is sufficient — no backend or database is warranted.

services.name: peninsula-interiors-site
services.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html styles.css script.js dist/ && cp -r assets dist/assets
